description: Preferred dense/default Candidate for one Spark, binding the exact official Qwen3.8 27B FP8 multimodal checkpoint. Current qualification proves bounded text chat only; vision serving remains unproven on Spark. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint.
title: Qwen3.8 27B FP8 vLLM single Spark
